description: Tasks template for the SupplyChain Frontend Azure modernization plan.

tasks.description: Capture the current SupplyChain Frontend behavior before modernization.
tasks.requirements: Snapshot the application's main source directory, src, and record a frozen test specification for the existing UI and backend API integration. Include the real/mock strategy for each external dependency; use mocks because no target Azure environment was provided.

tasks.description: Build integration tests for migrated Azure services and run post-migration verification
tasks.requirements: Use the frozen baseline test specification to verify the frontend after modernization. Use mocked backend API dependencies; no Azure integration resources were specified.

tasks.description: Scan project dependencies for known CVEs and remediate identified vulnerabilities.
tasks.requirements: Scan all project dependencies for known CVEs and remediate any identified vulnerabilities by upgrading to the minimum patched versions. If remediation requires a major-version upgrade, document the affected dependency, current and target versions, and breaking-change risks. Verify the project builds and its tests pass.

tasks.description: Deploy the SupplyChain Frontend to Azure Container Apps.
tasks.requirements: Deploy the existing frontend and its container image to an existing Azure Container Apps environment. Preserve the current UI routes and backend API integration. Do not provision new Azure infrastructure; obtain the target environment and deployment configuration before execution.
tasks.resourceStatus: Use an existing Azure Container Apps environment; target details are not provided.
